title: Top AI Companies Have ‘Unacceptable’ Risk Management, Studies Say
note: "No AI company scored better than “weak” in SaferAI’s assessment of their risk management maturity. The highest scorer was Anthropic (35%), followed by OpenAI (33%), Meta (22%), and Google DeepMind (20%). Elon Musk’s xAI scored 18%." Non-self confirmed source for the adverse-findings leg of R.5 on saferai.01.
